Other courses max 8 MC. We need to fit CS3281 (prereq for CS3282). CS3281 is 4 MC. We can fit CS3281 in Sem 6. Can we fit CS3227 in Sem 6? CS3227 is 4 MC. 4+4=8 MC. Yes. So Sem 6: CP3880, CS3281, CS3227. Sem 7: CS2102, CS4218, CS3103, CS3210. Sem 8: CS3282. This works. Last semester is 8. Can we finish in 7? No, because CS3282 requires CS3281. Sem 8 has CS3282, CS3210. This works. Last semester 8. Can we finish in 7? No. So earliest is 8. The plan is valid.
